title: LRU Cache O(1)
description:
Implement an `LRUCache` class with O(1) `get` and `put` using a **doubly-linked list** combined with a `Map`.

- `constructor(capacity)` — maximum number of entries
- `get(key)` — returns the value if present (moving it to most-recently-used), or `-1` if absent
- `put(key, value)` — inserts or updates the entry (moving it to most-recently-used); evicts the least-recently-used entry if over capacity

**Example:**
```js
const cache = new LRUCache(2);
cache.put(1, 'a');
cache.put(2, 'b');
cache.get(1);      // 'a'  — key 1 is now most-recent
cache.put(3, 'c'); // evicts key 2 (LRU)
cache.get(2);      // -1   — evicted
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using an array or shifting to maintain order (O(n)). The key insight is using a doubly-linked list with sentinel head/tail nodes so both insertion and removal are O(1), combined with a Map for O(1) key lookup.
